name: qa-markdown
description: InterviewRecord.qaMarkdown ('Copy all Q&A as Markdown'): '# name', then 'company — role' unless empty or equal to the name, then per turn a '## n. ' heading with [HH:MM:SS] from audio_to_ms when known and a per-kind prefix, a screenshot count, the answer or _(no answer)_, and an interrupted/failed mark. Blocks are joined by one blank line.

cases.name: Acme — iOS

# Acme — iOS

## 1. [00:01:05] why us

_1 screenshot(s)_

**Q:** Why us?
Because.

## 2. You: shorter

_(no answer)_

_(failed: offline)_
